newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Systems names William Ferry CEO.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Systems names William Ferry CEO.

text.p: Banyan Systems Inc said Tuesday it appointed William Ferry president and chief executive officer, effective February 24.
Ferry, 44, was most recently president of Wang Laboratories Inc's services division, where he led a global business in networking and customer services.
Ferry succeeds David Mahoney in the two posts. Mahoney, who was also former chairman, became Banyan's vice chairman of the board in November.
Banyan said Jeffrey Glidden, its acting president and chief operating officer during the management transition, will continue in his position as senior vice president and chief financial officer.
John Burton will continue as board chairman and Ferry will join the board as a director, it said.
Banyan provides network services that make it easy to find, share and management information and resources within enterprise systems.
